snippet.title: Flux Empyrean Trailer - "Fourth Aeon"
snippet.description:
The Fourth Aeon, that of stillness, is coming. You are the only thing in the way.

The ocean hides countless forgotten secrets. Echoes of calamity and loss scar the waves. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wit to solve the grand puzzle of the past. Rediscover truth in this expansive open world mystery.
